rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent within scope; project retained. The project sums Schedule B line 2 (total interest before the excludable savings-bond interest on line 3, which is refused and zero) and Schedule B line 6 (ordinary dividends); the second sums Form 1040 lines 2b and 3b, which are those Schedule B totals carried to Form 1040. Same values within scope (Form 4952 instructions pp. 3–4, line 4a).

Ruling: refusal representation; project retained. The project takes line 4g as the election and refuses the return through `f4952.bad_election` when 4g exceeds lines 4b plus 4e, and through `f4952.alternative_allocation` when the alternative allocation is chosen; the second transcription guards the same conditions inline. Equivalent within the non-refused scope.
